snippet.title: OS95 Plus! - Demo Available!
snippet.description:
The demo for OS95 Plus! has officially been released (and only three days late)! You can check out the demo for the first person puzzle adventure game on Steam and itch.io completely for free!

Steam Page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3782300
Itch.io Page: https://gevcreates.itch.io/os95-plus

Website: https://gevcreates.com
Discord Server: https://discord.gg/yJxgcQRDUK
More OS95 Plus! Videos: https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PLQ8icLD63q11N_nXbZx2ZqZ2hT-jhA1In
